title: Extended Heatwave Identification
scenario: Identify cities that experienced a heatwave (temp > 35°C) for 5 or more consecutive days.
tableSchema: weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC)
hint: Use date subtraction from a row number to create islands of consecutive dates.
correctQuery: SELECT city_name FROM (SELECT city_name, COUNT(*) as streak FROM (SELECT city_name, reading_date, (reading_date - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY city_name ORDER BY reading_date)::INT) as grp FROM weather_data WHERE temp_c > 35) t GROUP BY city_name, grp) t2 WHERE streak >= 5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC);
